subject: MAP: security wiring for Finify — gating & retention checklist
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@finify.com>, Sam O'Neill <sam.oneill@finify.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security wiring for Finify — gating & retention checklist

Hi Aisha / Sam —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our conversation, I’m attaching a first-pass MAP that wires the security/compliance gates into our mutual close plan. The goal is to: 1) make acceptance criteria explicit for SOC 2 and SIG/CAIQ checks, 2) capture DPA redline ownership and target dates, and 3) lock the data retention/archival windows that will be in the contract.

Attachments: finify_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners), SOC2-evidence-list.pdf (starter evidence inventory).

Quick summary of the security gates we plan to include in the MAP: 
- Entry gate: SOC 2 readiness call + list of evidence owners (expected within 10 business days)
- Technical gate: SIG assessment + CAIQ gap table (audit artifacts due to Finify by 2 weeks before UAT)
- Legal gate: DPA redlines agreed and signed (target sign-off prior to PO issuance)
- Operational gate: Data retention & residency decision (explicit retention windows and purge cadence)

Proposed milestones (high level):
- 2026-09-08: Evidence intake workshop (Redwood + Finify security) — identify evidence owners
- 2026-09-22: SIG/CAIQ gap table delivered to Finify
- 2026-09-30: DPA redlines consolidated by Kimberly
- 2026-10-07: Mutual acceptance (soft sign) / staged roll to sandbox

Action items I’m proposing now:
- Aisha: confirm Finify evidence owners and whether you want a dedicated SSO test account for CAIQ artifacts.
- Sam: confirm target retention window (default suggested: 30 days session data / 365 days logs, with optional 0-30/365 carveouts)
- Kimberly: we’ll loop you on DPA redlines — can you take lead on consolidating legal comments?

If those milestones look reasonable I’ll drop the MAP into the HubSpot deal and lock owners/deadlines in the attached XLSX.

Thanks —
Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: MAP: security wiring for Finify — gating & retention checklist

Thanks Markus — this is helpful. High-level responses and a couple of clarifying asks below: 

Responses: 
- Evidence owners: I’ll own overall coordination, but I’m assigning two people to the intake: Priya Singh (appsec) and Aaron Liu (infra). I’ll send their contact details by EOD Friday.
- CAIQ/ SIG: we prefer a live review session rather than handing a spreadsheet blind. Can Red team (someone from Redwood security) join a 90-minute walkthrough the week of 9/13?
- Retention windows: we need stronger alignment on logs retention. Finify’s baseline is 7 years for audit logs (regulated financial data). For session data we can accept 90 days if there’s a documented purge process.

Clarifying asks: 
1) For SOC 2 evidence: will Redwood provide a mapping between SOC 2 criteria and the evidence artifacts you expect? That will speed our intake.
2) DPA timing: Finify procurement needs a narrow review window — can we aim to have a DPA redline packet to legal by 9/15 so our procurement team can triage?

Priority timeline for us (tentative):
- 2026-09-10: evidence intake kickoff (Priya/Aaron join)
- 2026-09-16: joint SIG walkthrough (90 mins)
- 2026-09-15: DPA redlines due to Finify legal
- 2026-10-05: target for contract execution (we may need a short extension if SIG finds medium/high gaps)

I’m attaching a short note from procurement on the legal review cadence (see attachment: procurement_window.pdf). Also copying our compliance lead, Sam, to keep him in the loop.

Cheers,
Aisha

--
Aisha Kapoor
Chief Information Security Officer, Finify
aisha.kapoor@finify.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@finify.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security wiring for Finify — gating & retention checklist

Thanks — I’ll take the DPA redline consolidation. Two quick notes from legal that will feed the MAP: 

1) Retention carveouts: we can be flexible but need explicit tiers in the contract. Kimberly (legal) suggests: 
   - Tier A (Audit logs): up to 7 years (Finify request) — propose encrypted archival with HSM-backed keys, access controls, and documented export process.
   - Tier B (Operational logs / traces): 12 months by default, can be extended to 36 months for specific accounts on request.
   - Tier C (Session payloads / ephemeral input): default 90 days, with options for customer-managed retention controls in Private deployments.

2) DPA redline process: I will produce a single tracked document (DPA-redlines.docx) and highlight the critical clauses where Redwood needs to accept narrow carveouts (data residency & subprocessors). Please expect a consolidated packet by 2026-09-14 COB.

I’ll also add an evidence mapping table that ties SOC 2 control IDs to the artifacts requested — that should address Aisha’s question (we’ll attach SOC2-evidence-list.pdf as a living doc).

Kimberly

Perfect — thanks all for the quick turn. Finalizing next steps here and locking into the MAP on HubSpot. Summary / owners / deadlines (I’ll put these into the XLSX and HubSpot this afternoon):

1) Evidence intake workshop (virtual) — 2026-09-10 — owners: Markus + Aisha + Priya (Finify) + Aaron (Finify) + Jonas (Redwood SE) — deliverable: preliminary evidence inventory
2) SIG/CAIQ walkthrough — 2026-09-16 — owners: Jonas (lead on ops review) + Finify security + Redwood security (TBD) — deliverable: CAIQ gap table
3) DPA redline packet — deliverable: DPA-redlines.docx by 2026-09-14 (owner: Kimberly) — Finify legal to respond by 2026-09-15
4) Retention windows agreed and contract language drafted — 2026-09-22 — owners: Kimberly + Aisha + Rachel (ops)
5) Mutual acceptance (soft) / sandbox access — target 2026-10-05 — owner: Markus / Finify procurement

Open risk: Finify’s 7-year audit log requirement could trigger additional archival architecture on our side — Jonas, can you scope incremental effort for archival export and encryption options? Please add a notional estimate to the MAP workbook.

I’ll upload the updated XLSX (finify_MAP_v1.xlsx -> v1.1) to the Drive link and paste the HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/FIN-3421. If anyone wants a short triage call after Kimberly uploads the DPA redlines, I can schedule 30 minutes next week.
